# Your data

## Where is my data stored?

In a database on this device. There is no account, no server and no
background upload. See **Settings → Privacy and data**.

## How do I delete everything?

**Settings → Privacy and data → Delete app data.** It clears all
content and keeps your settings. To put the settings back to their
defaults too, use **Reset settings** - that one keeps your content.

## Does the app work offline?

Yes. Everything, including this FAQ and the manual, is bundled with
the app.

# Using the app

## Can I change the language?

**Settings → Language.** The first option follows your device
language and is the default.

## Why does the app ask for a permission only later?

Permissions are requested by the feature that needs them, at the
moment it needs them, with an explanation first. An app that asks
for everything on the first screen gets denied, and a denied
permission is hard to recover.

## What does "Pro" mean? Do I have to pay?

No. All features are currently free. The Pro page shows the
entitlement status; purchases are not enabled in this version.

# When something goes wrong

## The app did not start. What now?

The recovery screen offers **Try again**, which runs the startup
sequence from the top. If it keeps failing, use **Report the
problem** - the mail carries the app version and device details,
never your content.

## How do I report a bug or send feedback?

**Settings → About and help.** There is a support address, a
feedback address and a bug report that attaches the technical
details automatically.
